::: {.callout-warning title="BNR team draft"}
This page is a deliberately light structure for the BNR team to complete. It should describe the real abstraction process, not an idealised process imposed by the manual.
:::

## Purpose

Briefly explain how source information is reviewed and prepared for registry entry.

## When this applies

State which assessed events and source materials are covered.

## Responsibilities

Identify who abstracts, who checks and who resolves clinical uncertainty.

## What to document

Consider including:

- the abstraction form or REDCap instruments used;
- the preferred source for each essential field;
- how missing, conflicting and unclear information is recorded;
- the minimum checks before entry is considered complete; and
- whether a second check or sample review is used.

## Stop and escalate

State which uncertainties must be referred rather than inferred by the abstractor.

## Records to retain

State where source references, queries, reviewer decisions and completion status are recorded.
